name: Obby: +1 to Spaceflight Altitude 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Obby: +1 to Spaceflight Altitude is an adventure simulation space flight game that takes your cosmic adventures to new heights, literally, as your protagonist aims to fly. Step into the shoes of your customizable Obb character, upgrade your abilities, and fuel your rockets so you can soar across the galaxy.
